item.title: Deep River Symphony Orchestra presents mucial moods and storytelling
item.description: Pembroke native Brandon Wilkie is the cello soloist in the Deep River Symphony Orchestra’s upcoming concert on Feb. 28. Wilkie will perform Robert Schumann’s Cello Concerto in A minor which evokes moods ranging from passion and melancholy to desperation and optimism.
